CONSOLIDATED SOURCE AUDIT

Vision Traders unified workstation

Chosen base: the most complete TwelveData Indicator Engine build. Chart-interaction code is scoped into the native chart engine; alternate implementations were compared for drawing, order entry, indicator, replay and analytics strengths. This is the same terminal, not a second embedded app.

LOCAL HISTORICAL SOURCE——

Integrated strengths

MERGED
  • Chart engine: chart type transformations, chart navigation, cursor readouts, drawings, object tools, sync controls and multi-chart layout.
  • Execution: market/limit/stop simulation, brackets, risk preview, positions, orders and trade ledger.
  • Replay & data: OHLC CSV import/merge, local history persistence, deterministic bar replay, plus one-event-per-step replay when tick CSV is imported.
  • Analysis: technical indicators, candlestick pattern analysis, volume-profile estimate, strategy tester, risk/journal tools and report export.
  • Data connectors: optional Twelve Data market history, tape/options CSV, and historical Level 2 CSV adapter.

Quick actions

LOCAL FILES

Tick CSV columns: timestamp, price (or last), optional size/volume, side, bid, ask. Level 2 CSV supports timestamp + side + price + size, or timestamp + bid_price/bid_size + ask_price/ask_size. Rows are shown only at or before the replay cursor.
